mapper.sql: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_code, supplier_name, supplier_short_name, supplier_type, supplier_level, unified_credit_code, contact_person, contact_phone, email, fax, website, postcode, address, legal_person, registered_capital, enterprise_nature, business_scope, established_date, bank_name, bank_branch, bank_account, tax_number, invoice_title, invoice_address, invoice_phone, payment_method, payment_days, settlement_type, currency, delivery_cycle, min_order_amount, cooperation_date, qualification_status, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM wms_supplier
